neighbours.label: The marker that opens the last member of a series: 'Finally,' closing an enumerated argument and 'else:' closing an if/elif chain
fire: There are three reasons the plan failed. To begin with, the budget was too small. In addition, the staff were poorly trained. Finally, the deadline was moved forward twice.
Several steps are needed to restore the painting. First, the surface dirt is removed. Then the old varnish is dissolved. Finally, the losses are filled and retouched.
The report makes a number of points. It notes that rents have risen. It also shows that wages have stalled. Finally, it warns that savings are falling.
We thank many people for this book. Our editor read every draft. Our families put up with long absences. Finally, our students tested each chapter in class.
Critics raised several objections. Some said the sample was too small. Others doubted the method. Finally, a few questioned whether the data were real.
quiet: There are three reasons the plan failed. To begin with, the budget was too small. In addition, the staff were poorly trained. The deadline was moved forward twice.
Several steps are needed to restore the painting. First, the surface dirt is removed. Then the old varnish is dissolved by a trained conservator.
The report makes a number of points. It notes that rents have risen. It also shows that wages have stalled and that savings are falling.
We thank many people for this book. Our editor read every draft. Our families put up with long absences while we wrote it.
Critics raised several objections. Some said the sample was too small. Others doubted the method, and a few questioned the data.

notes: Card: ' else' x5, 'Finally' x6 in three casings, ' and' before a last list item, ' third', ' course'. Probes: 'Finally' after 'To begin with ... In addition ...' 0.47, 'else:' after if/elif 0.45, 'and a third' 0.51; short versions much weaker ('Finally' after two short steps 0.07, two-branch else 0.03, 'X, Y and Z' 0.09-0.25). Fire items therefore carry the earlier members of the series; near misses stop before the closing marker or use a non-final one.
